name: com.greetigo/birthday-reminders
title: Greetigo Birthday Reminders
description: Turn a list of birthdays into a reminder plan and a link that sets up free email reminders.

tools.name: plan_birthday_reminders
tools.description: For a list of people with a birthday, work anniversary or anniversary (month and day, year optional), returns each next date, the days until it, and the age or number of years it marks when a year is given, soonest first. Also returns a link that opens this list in Greetigo; nothing is saved until the user presses Save there. A Feb 29 date falls on Feb 28 in years without Feb 29. Dates that do not exist are refused with a message. Up to 100 people per call. Reads nothing and stores nothing.

people.description: The people and their dates, 1 to 100.

name.description: The person's name, as the user says it.

year.description: Optional: the year of birth, of the start date or of the wedding.

today.description: Optional: the user's own date today, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today in UTC.

tools.name: about_greetigo
tools.description: Describes Greetigo: what it does, what the free plan holds, what the paid plan costs, and links to the home page, the employee birthday tracker and the privacy policy. Takes no input.
